Each download link is made fresh when you click it and expires after a few minutes, so open files from this page rather than saving the download address. Season-pass files are replaced in place every morning: same name, more rows.

## Recover your library

On a new device, or lost the link? Enter the email you paid with and the receipt number from your Stripe receipt.

```{=html}
<form class="store-recover" data-store-recover>
  <label>Email <input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required></label>
  <label>Receipt number <input type="text" name="receipt" placeholder="1234-5678" pattern="#?[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}" required></label>
  <button type="submit" class="btn store-add">Find my library</button>
  <span class="store-note" data-store-recover-status role="status"></span>
</form>
```

Bought more than once with different emails? Each email has its own library. [Email us](mailto:slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com) and we will merge them.
